entries.note: The label, before the sender drops the parcel off.

entries.wording: Parcel was dropped off at the locker
entries.note: Also worded "Parcel was dropped off at the parcel shop".
Also "In transit to <town>, <country>" and "The parcel is on its way to the locker (<point>)". Only a sorting centre's town becomes the scan's location.

entries.wording: Parcel redirected to the parcel shop
entries.note: The selected point could not take the parcel, which goes on to another point, a hub ("to the hub", "to the locker") or another network ("Change: Parcel redirected to Colissimo").
The tracker shows this milestone with the new tracking code and the other network's link; no reply showed it, so the wording is a placeholder.

entries.wording: Ready to collect at the locker
entries.note: Also "Ready to collect at the parcel shop".

entries.wording: Parcel was collected by the recipient
entries.note: A second scan worded "Delivered" follows within a second; the adapter leaves it out.
The tracker's label for the milestone.

entries.wording: Return: Parcel will be returned. Reason: pickup time has expired

entries.note: Every movement on the return leg takes the parcel back to its sender.
The tracker's label: the returned parcel waits for its sender at a point.
Later scans can show the parcel found again.
Left without a stage: the tracker's code names the milestone without a label, and no reply showed it.
